headline: Sensex Surges 1,300 Points and Nifty Tops 25,300 as Oil Prices Decline and FII Buying Aids Market Rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Significant decline in global oil prices
Resurgence of Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) buying activity
Strong performance in the automobile and banking sectors
Positive global market cues and a strong opening on Dalal Street
whatHappening: The BSE Sensex jumped over 1,300 points intraday while the Nifty 50 crossed the 25,300 mark
Investor wealth increased by approximately ₹4.5 lakh crore within the first few minutes of trading
Kalyan Jewellers shares hit a fresh 52-week high following a strong start to the third quarter
Cochin Shipyard shares fell 7.4% after the company reported its second-quarter financial results
summary: Indian benchmark indices surged today, with the Sensex gaining over 1,300 points and Nifty crossing the 25,300 level. The rally was supported by falling oil prices and strong FII buying, leading to a significant increase in market capitalization. While auto and banking stocks performed well, Cochin Shipyard saw a sharp decline following its Q2 earnings report.
